text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Pandora! Oh my, look at that 
splendid bedhead! While you fix it up, go 
wash your face too♪

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
It's already time for school, ya know?! 
Were you training right up to the very 
last minute again?!

text_block_list.name: Heart & Blast
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Pandora! Same as always, huh. Eye 
really needs to catch her breath and...

text_block_list.name: Heart & Blast
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And so, you get today entirely off! I 
heard from Blast that you've been pushing 
yourself too hard, you know? Once in a 
while, try living like Pandora♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah. Just for today, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
For now... is it okay if I change into my 
uniform? Forget going to morning training, 
homeroom is already about to start...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...That's a NO, Eye. Granted, it really is 
time to get changed, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
This is the point where that girl starts 
watching videos!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"U U U U U U U U U U U UMA! U U U UMA! U U 
U U U UMA!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Dancing along to 'Dance Cover' videos is 
her routine—come on, you do it too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This is definitely not the time to be 
dancing, right!?!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Eye always writes down her daily goals in 
the morning! You should try doing the 
same, Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Today's goalss~? ...For now, get my nails 
done, right? Buy some new clothes~, maybe 
get eyelash extensions too~♪

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That's such a Pandora goal!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~♪ By the way, you're comin' 
with me, Blast-chan, okay?♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"My Eye and your love Overlapping 
together, illuminating the world Becoming 
a Star"♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Way-way-waaay!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Are you all sure you just want to do 
backup shouts? I've already sung four 
songs in a row, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's just the usual Pandora 
style. She's always like, "I'm totally in 
the groove☆"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And then, just like you are now, Eye, she 
hypes up the mood more and more! Come on, 
come on, let's do one more song☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm boreeeed~~~~. Are you really 
gonna study the entire time~?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We teach each other subjects we're 
good at, which makes it very informative.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
What is your best subject, Pandora-san? 
Since we're all here, would you mind 
teaching us...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~... Ah, how about fashion! Trends and 
stuff~ I'm super knowledgeable on that for 
real♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Y-You went out of your way to deliver it 
to me in person?! I did say I wanted a 
training textbook, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it at all! I was told 
that today I could treat you just like 
Pan-chan. Is there anything else you'd 
like?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, no, really! This is already more than 
enough...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Train until you're the absolute last one 
left"? No way, no way, impossible!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, wait! I just had a genius idea♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Everyone~, pushing yourselves too hard is 
forbidden~~~~! You gotta keep your body 
healthy to run in the first place~! 
Resting before you get tired is the most 
important thing of all~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, Pandora-san...! Such lovely, 
thoughtful words truly resonate with my 
heart!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~♪ I'm gonna give it my all 
calling out to everyone until the very 
last person♡

Around lunchtime one day—I happened upon a 
group of horse girls chatting in the 
center of the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, after resting so thoroughly 
yesterday! Today I'll push through 
double... no, triple yesterday's training!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~ for real!? Eye-chan, you're way too 
hardworking~... Since I worked suuuper 
hard yesterday, for me—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Today is a "pamper myself" day~♡ 
Department store basement sweets, and 
staying up late for sure!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no! I was hoping you two would learn 
from each other... Well, I suppose it's 
never that easy.

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! But still, Boo loves both of you 
just the way you are!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's true, your lifestyle was refreshing, 
Pandora-san... and fun.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! ...Hey hey, next time, 
let's book a fancy hotel and spend the 
whole day together! That way we can 
understand each other even better!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll be way more fun and 
sparkly! ...Sounds great, right~? Right, 
right?
